summary: Phase 4 (Handover & Close) independently verified end-to-end with owner@isodemo.com. Backend: 8/8 pytest cases pass (not-ready view with both reasons + 1 install suggestion, complete→400, auto-jobs creating a real db.issues install job visible via GET /api/issues, PO+GRN delivery, 100% stage invoice, ready=true, complete→'completed', double-complete 400, reopen→'open', force-complete with reason, explicit ppm job, invalid case_type fallback, empty payload 400, 404s, auth guards, open jobs non-blocking). Frontend: full handover panel exercised in /crm → Corporate → Quotes → quote detail — badge 'Open', 3 checklist items, Complete deal DISABLED with both reasons listed, auto-create install jobs → job row appears, Add-job dialog (type=ppm + title) → 2nd job, force dialog (submit disabled until reason) → badge flips to 'Completed' + Reopen shown + auto-jobs/Add-job hidden, Reopen → badge back to 'Open'. No console errors, no error elements. All TEST_ quotes/issues/svc_cases/equipment/POs/invoices cleaned up.

minor.issue: Reopen only unsets deal_completed_at/by — deal_completed_forced (true) and deal_completed_reason survive on the quote after reopening, so a re-opened deal still reads as 'force completed' in the DB/audit view. Also there is no guard: reopening an already-open deal returns 200 and rewrites deal_status.

_mirror_issue_to_svc_case is called but is a silent no-op for handover jobs: it returns early unless issue_doc.resolution_type == 'engineer', which _build_issue_doc does not set for these jobs. Verified 0 svc_cases rows for a quote with 2 handover jobs. If Service Desk visibility is intended, set resolution_type='engineer' (or mirror explicitly); otherwise drop the misleading call.

issues: Reason text shows raw floats/currency codes: 'Not fully invoiced — GBP 5000.0 still to invoice' (backend f-string) — should be formatted (e.g. £5,000.00)
Checklist row reads '2 open job(s) — informational' with an unchecked circle in warning-muted colour; it looks like a blocker even though open jobs do not block completion
Cookie-consent banner sits fixed over the bottom of the quote detail page (did not block the handover controls in this run, but overlaps page content)
